title: The Sampling Complexity of Condorcet Winner Identification in Dueling Bandits
abstract: arXiv:2603.15189v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: We study best-arm identification in large-scale stochastic dueling bandits under the sole assumption that a Condorcet winner exists, i.e., an arm that wins each noisy pairwise comparison with probability at least $1/2$. We introduce a new identification procedure that exploits the full gap matrix $\Delta_{i,j}=q_{i,j}-\tfrac12$ (where $q_{i,j}$ is the probability that arm $i$ beats arm $j$), rather than only the gaps between the Condorcet winner and the other arms. We derive high-probability, instance-dependent sample-complexity guarantees that (up to logarithmic factors) improve the best known ones by leveraging informative comparisons beyond those involving the winner. We complement these results with matching lower bounds that establish the optimality of our procedures in all regimes. Overall, our results reveal the general form of the sampling complexity, characterized by a trade-off between the cost of locating informative

translated_title: 对决老虎机中孔多塞胜者识别的采样复杂度
translated_abstract: 我们在大规模随机对决老虎机中研究最优臂识别问题，仅假设存在孔多塞胜者，即以至少 1/2 的概率赢得每次含噪两两比较的臂。我们提出了一种新的识别方法，该方法利用完整的间隔矩阵 $\Delta_{i,j}=q_{i,j}-\tfrac{1}{2}$（其中 $q_{i,j}$ 是臂 $i$ 击败臂 $j$ 的概率），而不仅仅利用孔多塞胜者与其他臂之间的间隔。我们推导出了高概率、依赖于实例的样本复杂度保证，通过利用涉及胜者之外的有信息比较，在（对数因子上）改进了已知最好的结果。我们用匹配的下界补充了这些结果，证明了我们的方法在所有情形下的最优性。总体而言，我们的结果揭示了采样复杂度的一般形式，其特征在于定位有信息比较的成本与其他代价之间的权衡。
tldr: 提出一种利用完整间隔矩阵的孔多塞胜者识别算法，其样本复杂度在所有情形下达到最优（上下界匹配），并揭示了采样复杂度由定位有信息比较的成本所刻画的权衡结构。
en_tdlr: Proposes a Condorcet winner identification procedure that exploits the full gap matrix, achieving optimal instance-dependent sample complexity with matching upper and lower bounds, and reveals a general sampling complexity trade-off characterized by the cost of locating informative comparisons.
